title: Harbor ferry delays expected through April

versions.body: The Eastfield–Northpoint ferry will run every 40 minutes instead of 20 while the north dock is repaired. Commuters are advised to allow extra time, or to take the 14 bus, which is also late.

title: Eastfield library raises $18,000 for new children's corner

versions.body: A bake sale, a used-book fair and one very determined children's librarian, Priya Shah, raised $18,000. 'We're naming the reading nook after a colleague,' Shah said, declining to say more.

title: Port Calder High robotics team heads to state finals

versions.body: The Calder Cogs, whose robot 'Gerald' can stack eleven crates in ninety seconds, will compete in the state finals. No relation to any local CEO, the team insists.

title: Week ahead: fog, then more fog

versions.body: Harbor fog through Wednesday, clearing Thursday afternoon. Highs of 9°C. Bring a jacket to anything held near the water.

title: Route 14 bus to skip Harbor Street stops during roadworks

versions.body: Riders will walk an extra four minutes. The transit authority apologises 'for the inconvenience and for the wind'.

title: Harbor Festival draws record crowd despite rain

versions.body: An estimated 9,000 people ate fish and chips under umbrellas. The festival's annual rubber duck race was won by duck #212.

title: Council again delays Route 9 bike lane

versions.body: A protected bike lane at Route 9 and Harbor Street, recommended after several crashes, has been pushed to the 2027 budget. Cyclists say they have heard this before.

title: @chefroberta: Chowder secrets

title: @gabe_runs: Harbor loop

title: @notsofastfood: New taco place on 4th

title: Port Calder — Calderpedia

versions.body: Port Calder is a coastal city of about 210,000 people. Districts include Eastfield (harbour), Northpoint, Old Town and the Heights. Its newspaper is The Daily Record. It is known for fog, ferries and an unusually high number of chowder competitions.

title: HarborDesk — Virtual offices in Port Calder

versions.body: Get a prestigious address at 18 Harbor Street from $29/month. Mail scanning, call answering, and a meeting room you'll probably never need.

title: Salty's Fish Bar — since 1971

versions.body: Open daily 11–21. Cod, haddock, and the famous harbor chowder. We did NOT change the oil in 2019.

title: Eastfield Community Garden

versions.body: 42 plots, a tool shed and too many zucchini. Waitlist: 2 years. Work days every second Saturday. Plot holders listed on the shed noticeboard.

title: Northgate unveils Eastfield Waterfront plan

versions.body: Northgate Development CEO Gerald Whitcombe presented plans for four towers on the Calder Mill site. 'Eastfield is ready,' he said. Several residents in the audience disagreed loudly.

title: Save the Mill petition reaches 4,100 signatures

versions.body: Organizers led by local librarian Mara Quinn delivered the petition to City Hall in a wheelbarrow. 'She's an old girl, but she's ours,' Quinn told reporters.
